player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} muri mugoroba wa {max_rounds} wa Kuhn Poker.
Itegeko ry'umukino:
- Kuhn Poker itumaga kaari 3 na J, Q, K (J ifite, K ikirenga)
- Umukino wese atanga {ante} chip na kapata kaari 1 kuri mugoroba (kumbuka ko kaari zitangwa ziriko, kandi siwe wa kaari moja na umukino wawe)
- Umukino ugeza kugeza {max_rounds} mugoroba
- Umukino utunze chip nyinshi nyuma y'amugoroba yose
Itegeko ry'umwanzo:
- '[check]': Gusa (iyo umwanzo siwe ku meza)
- '[bet]': Ongera chip 1 ku mutungo (iyo umwanzo siwe ku meza)
- '[call]': Kuranisha umwanzo w'umukino wawe kwa kuongeza chip 1 ku mutungo
- '[fold]': Taba umukino wawe na umukino wawe utunze mutungo

init_round.round_start: ### Kuzamuka kwa mugoroba {current_round} kuva {max_rounds} mugoroba. Katika kaari yawe: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Kurasa: Umukino {winner} '{winner_card}' ikiri Umukino {loser} '{loser_card}'. Umukino {winner} utunze mutungo wa {pot_value} chip.

outcome.draw: At the end of {max_rounds} rounds, both players had the same number of chips.
outcome.winner_player0: Umukinnyi 0 yatsinze kuko yari afite chips nyinshi kurangiza imikino yose {max_rounds}.
outcome.winner_player1: Umukinnyi 1 yatsinze afite chips nyinshi kurangiza {max_rounds} imiterere yose.
